change_vs_v1: the shot-rate shrinkage centre is the role multiplier mu[position][quintile of predicted TOI] (fitted on earlier seasons) instead of 1.0; nothing else changes

role_prior.edges: quantiles of the training seasons' predicted TOI per position
role_prior.multiplier: sum(actual shots) / sum(shots at the point-in-time league rate for the minutes actually played), per position x bucket, training seasons only, clipped to [0.5, 1.5]

skaters_all_required: ladder Brier(WORKLOAD_V2) - ladder Brier(CHAMPION_NB): 95% CI upper < 0
CRPS no worse than CHAMPION_NB for forwards AND for defencemen (point estimates)
ADDED: no predicted-TOI quintile has |bias| > 0.06 shots per skater-game
acceptance.verdicts: ACCEPTED only if every check passes in EVERY one of the three held-out seasons; otherwise REJECTED. ACCEPTED would mean 'eligible for a prospective shadow test' and never promotion; the historical seasons are development evidence, not independent confirmation.

secondary_reported: WORKLOAD_V2 minus WORKLOAD_V1 (CRPS, RMSE, ladder Brier, MAE with 95% CIs)
bias by predicted-TOI quintile for CHAMPION, WORKLOAD_V1, WORKLOAD_V2
